I haven't read the statement in detail or done any play-testing yet. My feedback below is focused primarily on the high-level presentation and structure of the statement.

* Here's a link to a statement for your reference: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/1516179aa763a6302dbdfa2c8676688ed085c3 (click "Test in ide").

* Use <const> instead of <var> to format constants. Use <action> instead of <var> to format action verbs (e.g. PLACE, WAIT).

* Please add separate sections for "League introduction" (at the beginning of the statement) and "League preview" (at the end of the statement). Refer to the linked statement (the green boxes) for the required HTML code.

* Please add separate sections for "Victory Conditions" and "Defeat Conditions" (the teal box and the red box). Refer to the linked statement for the required HTML code.

* If appropriate, consider adding diagrams or images to illustrate the concepts.

* Please apply the appropriate background colour, and the line number text colour for the game input/output section. Refer to… you know :)

* Please specify variable type (e.g. "two space-separated integers", "an integer") and description for all variables in the game input/output section.

* Please change these headings:
  • Initialization => Initialization input
  • Each turn => Input for one game turn
  • Output => Output for one game turn

* Please format the above three and "Constraints" headings properly.

* Constraints: Please split the constraints into individual points, with one constraint per line.

* Consider adding a link to the referee code.

* If the game concept is based on an existing game or another source, please acknowledge and credit the original creator or source.

* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.

Hello! Glintwatch is a 2-4 player simultaneous bot game. Each player owns a lamp on one edge of a reef and bends its beam with shared mirrors. A crystal only pays the player who lights it alone, and pays more the longer that player holds it.

The 4 leagues add the rules step by step: mirrors, then rocks and turning mirrors, then a limited mirror supply with wear, then crystal tides and values.

Feedback welcome: is the statement clear enough to write a first bot? Are the league steps the right size? Is the viewer readable with 4 beams?

How it was made: I designed and directed this game; the rules, code, art and texts were produced with AI agents under my review. Everything is original.

Thanks for the review!
Done: league introduction and preview boxes, separate victory and defeat blocks, const and action tags, typed input descriptions with the standard headings, one constraint per line, small diagrams, a link to the referee code, a credit line and a cover.
The rules are unchanged.
Thank you! I'll review the contribution again within the next few days.

Rules - The reef
* Please rewrite the beginning of the paragraph as follows:

The reef is represented as a square grid. The <var>x</var>-coordinate indicates the column (<const>0</const> at the left), and the <var>y</var>-coordinate indicates the row (<const>0</const> at the top/north).

* The range of possible grid sizes need not be stated here, as it is covered under Constraints.

* Please start a new paragraph with "2 to 4 players".

* The phrase "empty lamp lines" is unclear. Do you mean that the initial straight-line paths of the beams are unobstructed?

* Please format "1" in "worth 1" using the <const> tag.

Rules - Beams
* Please replace "After… north" with:
A lamp fires a straight-line beam towards the opposite edge.

* Please split the paragraph into bullet points.

Rules - Mirrors
* Please revise the diagram to match the order of the table. Swapping the 2nd and 4th items in the bottom row should be sufficient.

Rules - Mirror supply
* Please omit "in every league" if the rule holds for every league.

* Consider replacing "at the start of turns 10, 20, 30 ..." with "at the start of every 10th turn, beginning with turn 10".

* Please replace "the input of that turn already counts it" with "The additional mirror is already included in the turn's input."

* Consider avoiding the word "hand" altogether, as it may be slightly unintuitive in this context. For example:
- Each player starts with 12 mirrors available for placement.
- The number of available mirrors is not capped.
- A shattered mirror is permanently lost and is not returned to the player.

Rules - Actions
* Please change "prints" to "outputs".

* Again, consider replacing references to mirrors in a player's hand with "available mirrors".

* Please remove the paragraph about messages. It's unimportant and can be mentioned exclusively in the Output section.

* Yards, Impossible actions, Invalid lines: Please split the descriptions into bullet points.

Rules - Order of a turn
* Please change "Supply (before the input is sent), on turns 10, 20, 30 ..." to "Mirror supply (at the start of every 10th turn)".

Rules - General
* I'd suggest reorganising the sections slightly as follows:

(^ = unchanged)
^ The reef
Cells (split from "The reef")
^ Lamps and beams (renamed from "Beams")
^ Mirrors
^ Mirror supply
Placement restrictions (move "Yards" and "Same cell" here)
^ Actions
^ Scoring
^ Order of a turn
^ End of the game

Game Input/Output
* Please simplify the player ID description by using 0 to number of players - 1 instead of explicitly listing all possible IDs.

* There's no need to list the edges individually when explaining the clockwise ordering of players. "Clockwise order" should be sufficient.

(continued) Initialization input * It feels slightly unusual to provide `size` after `reef`. Please consider swapping the order of these two fields. * Consider representing the reef as `size` separate lines, each containing `size` characters, rather than as one long string. * Consider providing the number of players explicitly as an input field, rather than requiring players to deduce it from the number of lamps in the reef. Output for one game turn * Please change "A single line with" to "One line:". * Please format "hello" using instead of . I haven't finished reviewing the statement yet, but I think there are quite a few changes to consider, so I'll pause here. Thanks.
